test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The police later ________ that one of the thieves had been arrested.
solution: The correct answer is '**confirmed**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**confirmed**'. • It means **'to say or show that something is true or correct, especially by giving evidence'.** (विशेषतः प्रमाण देकर किसी बात की पुष्टि करना) • *Example: Seeing the two of them together **confirmed** our suspicions.* • Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2**. **Correct Sentence:__** *The police later __**confirmed**__ that one of the thieves had been arrested.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **abandoned**: left completely and no longer used or wanted. (अनचाही वस्‍तु को पूर्ण रूप से त्‍यागा या छोड़ा हुआ; परित्‍यक्त) • **commenced**: to start or begin. (आरंभ होना) • **analysed**: to look at or think about the different parts or details of something carefully in order to understand or explain it. (विश्‍लेषण करना; किसी तत्‍व के विभिन्‍न पक्षों का अध्ययन एवं परीक्षण करना) 204:Td1c, The correct answer is '**Patriarchy**'.
